method: breaths by loudness (under -14 dB for 0.2 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 12 of 15 breaks heard

lines.latin: Benedíctus Deus, Benedíctum nomen sanctum ejus.
lines.english: Blessed be God. Blessed be His holy Name.

lines.latin: Benedíctus Jesus Christus verus Deus et verus homo.
lines.english: Blessed be Jesus Christ, true God and true Man.

lines.latin: Benedíctum nomen Jesu. Benedíctum Cor ejus sacratíssimum.
lines.english: Blessed be the Name of Jesus. Blessed be His most Sacred Heart.
Blessed be His most Precious Blood.

lines.latin: Benedíctus Jesus in sanctíssimo altáris Sacraménto.
lines.english: Blessed be Jesus in the most holy Sacrament of the altar.
Blessed be the Holy Ghost, the Paraclete.

lines.latin: Benedícta magna Mater Dei, María sanctíssima.
lines.english: Blessed be the great Mother of God, Mary most holy.

lines.latin: Benedícta sancta ejus et immaculáta Concéptio.
lines.english: Blessed be her holy and Immaculate Conception.
Blessed be the name of Mary,
Blessed be God in His Angels
So be it! So be it!
